$comment: Golden cases for the layout-intent skills. Each case gives a design/code input and the decisions a correct agent must make. Run them with any agent (see evals/README.md) and score the intent sheet against `expect`.

cases.input: Figma frame 'Home' 360x1400, vertical Auto Layout, padding 16, gap 16. Child 'Products': Auto Layout horizontal, wrap on, gap 12, Fill container width; contains 6 instances of component 'Card/Product' (Hug height, Fill width in a 2-up wrap). Each card: padding 12, corner radius 8, image with locked 4:3 ratio, title text 16/24 (2 lines max), price text 14, 1px divider.

must_not: LazyColumn of rows built by hand

cases.input: Screenshot (1170 px wide) of a row of 5 promo cards; the 4th card is cut at the right edge. No structure data.

expect.export-scale: 3x (1170 ÷ 390): divide pixels by 3 before anything else

Promos.confidence: < 0.8 (screenshot only) → listed under needs review or asked

expect.code: ListView.builder(scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal) or PageView, spacing in .sdp
must_not: pixel values used as logical units

cases.input: SwiftUI: HStack(spacing: 8) { Image(systemName: "star").frame(width: 24, height: 24); Text(title).font(.system(size: 15)) }.padding(.horizontal, 16).frame(minHeight: 44); Divider()
List item: padding 16, avatar 40, title 16sp, subtitle 14sp, row min height 72.
Two frames: 'Landing — Mobile' 390x2400 and 'Landing — Desktop' 1440x900. Hero title 32 on mobile, 56 on desktop. Content max width 1200 on desktop.

expect.base: mobile frame is the base; desktop differences become adapt overrides (@w840/@w1200)
expect.title: fs:32assp (or fssp) + fs@w1200:<value> — not 56 normalized against 900
must_not: sdp tokens normalized from the 1440x900 frame

cases.input: const styles = StyleSheet.create({ card: { padding: 16, borderRadius: 12 }, title: { fontSize: 18 } }); used in <Card/>.

expect.pattern: createDimenStyles(() => ({ … })) + const styles = useStyles() in the component
must_not: StyleSheet.create with sdp() at module scope (never updates)

cases.input: WPF settings window: padding 24, section gap 16, labels 14, max content width 720.

expect.family: AppDimens.Net (strategies needed for desktop) — not SDPS
expect.tokens: {ad:ASdp …} is not a markup name → C# 24.ASdp() or bounded {ad:FSdp 24}; text {ad:Ssp 14}

cases.input: Puzzle game: 8x8 board must always be fully visible; pause button 48 in the corner; score text 20; background art must cover the screen.
Design a settings screen with a list of toggles and a profile header.

expect.structure: Auto Layout everywhere; toggles as one ListItem/Toggle component repeated; [list] tag
